# One parse rule per knob type, and the same rule in every runtime.
#
# `type|input|expected`, one case per line. `expected` is the value the text
# means, or `error` when the text is not a value of that type at all — a reader
# answers its row's default for those, and the controller's boot refuses on
# every type but `positive_int` and `bool`, because an operator who sets a knob
# and silently gets the default back has been told a knob exists that does
# nothing.
#
# `<empty>` is the empty string. Inputs are trimmed before they are parsed, so
# a value pasted with a stray space still means what it looks like.
#
# Every runtime's own suite feeds this file to its own reader:
#   test/flezha/config/parse_test.exs          the controller
#   sdk/elixir/test/flezha/sdk/knob_test.exs   the Elixir SDK
#   flz_transport/src/env.rs                   the crates and the Rust SDK
#   sdk/java/.../FlezhaEnvTest.java            Java
#   sdk/node/test/env.test.mjs                 Node
#   sdk/python/tests/test_env.py               Python
#   sdk/ruby/test/env_test.rb                  Ruby
#   sdk/php/tests/EnvTest.php                  PHP

positive_int|5|5
positive_int| 7 |7
positive_int|1048576|1048576
positive_int|1|1
positive_int|0|error
positive_int|-1|error
positive_int|abc|error
positive_int|3x|error
positive_int|<empty>|error

ms|0|0
ms|250|250
ms| 900 |900
ms|-1|error
ms|1.5|error
ms|abc|error
ms|<empty>|error

int|42|42
int|-3|-3
int|0|0
int|4.5|error
int|abc|error

bool|true|true
bool|TRUE|true
bool|yes|true

bool|0|false
bool|false|false
bool|No|false
bool|OFF|false
bool|maybe|error
bool|2|error
